product.title: Prima mea carte de activitati Montessori. Istoria lumii
product.description: Bine ați venit în călătoria noastră Montessori prin istorie. Datorită celor peste 50 de activități pedagogice și ludice, copiii vor putea, începând cu vârsta de 6 ani, să descopere marile perioade din istoria lumii, de la Big Bang la Declarația drepturilor omului și ale cetățeanului!   • Fiecare perioadă a istoriei (formarea Pământului, Preistoria, Antichitatea, Evul Mediu, epoca modernă…) este introdusă printr-o activitate de descoperire, apoi copilului îi sunt propuse jocuri pentru aprofundarea cunoașterii perioadei și a evenimentelor care au marcat-o (scene de completat, imagini de ales, călătorii de urmărit pe o hartă etc.). Materialul de decupat aflat la sfârșitul caietului este util pentru motricitate și aprofundare. • Noțiunea de cronologie este abordată grație unei frize ilustrate care se continuă de-a lungul întregului caiet, însoțește toate activitățile și îi permite copilului să situeze în timp personajele și evenimentele unele în raport cu celelalte. • Conform principiilor pedagogiei Montessori, acest caiet propune activități bazate pe experimentarea senzorială: copilul este invitat să-și confecționeze propriul papirus, să realizeze o miniatură ca într-un manuscris medieval, să construiască una dintre mașinăriile de zbor ale lui Leonardo da Vinci…   Cu: Imagini autocorectoare, puzzle-uri, jucării de hârtie de confecționat acasă.

# Prima Mea Montessori World History Activity Book by Litera

**Price:** 54.99

Discover the vast expanse of time and history with the **Prima Mea Montessori World History Activity Book**. Designed for young learners, this comprehensive resource takes children on a guided journey through human civilization, blending foundational historical knowledge with hands-on, sensorially engaging activities rooted in Montessori principles.

## ð A Journey Through Time: From Big Bang to Modernity

This activity book is more than just a workbook; it's an interactive educational tool that allows children aged 6 and up to explore the major periods of world history. Students will trace the story of humanity, starting from the cosmic origins of the Big Bang all the way through to key milestones like the Declaration of the Rights of Man and Citizen.

Each historical eraâincluding the formation of Earth, Prehistory, Antiquity, the Middle Ages, and the modern periodâis explored through a unique discovery activity. To deepen understanding, children engage with varied educational games designed to solidify knowledge about crucial events and figures.

### Interactive Learning Experiences for Young Minds

The book is structured for maximum engagement, ensuring that learning remains fun and exploratory:

*   **Chronology Focus:** A beautifully illustrated timeline runs throughout the entire workbook. This continuous visual aid helps children accurately place characters and events in their correct temporal relationship, building a strong sense of historical chronology.
*   **Hands-On Activities:** Learning is achieved through practical exercises such as fill-in-the-blank scenes, image selection puzzles, map journeys, and more.
*   **Sensory & Craft Integration (Montessori Principles):** True to Montessori pedagogy, the book encourages sensory experience and craftsmanship. Children are invited to:
    *   Craft their own papyrus.
    *   Create a miniature manuscript reminiscent of the medieval era.
    *   Build models of Leonardo da Vinci's flight machines.

### Built for Skill Development

Beyond historical knowledge, this activity book enhances vital developmental skills:

*   **Fine Motor Skills:** The included cutout material at the end of the booklet is specifically designed to improve dexterity and fine motor control.
*   **Cognitive Development:** Through puzzles and auto-correcting images, children boost their problem-solving abilities while absorbing facts about world history.
*   **Format Variety:** Featuring puzzle elements, autocorrector images, and craft paper activities, the book maintains high engagement throughout the learning process.

---

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the target age group for this activity book?**
A: The book is recommended for children starting from age 6.

**Q: Does it cover physical crafting or just drawing?**
A: No, it encourages both activities and craftwork, including creating papyrus and miniature manuscripts, adhering to Montessori principles of sensory experimentation.

**Q: Is understanding the sequence of events a focus?**
A: Yes, a key feature is the illustrated timeline that helps students grasp chronology and place events correctly in time.

---
*For more educational resources and learning materials, visit [https://www.litera.ro/prima-mea-carte-de-activitati-montessori-istoria-lumii-cedmont20](https://www.litera.ro/prima-mea-carte-de-activitati-montessori-istoria-lumii-cedmont20).*
